findings.title: Inherited finding becomes an endpoint
findings.claim: Across the supplied wider parallels, the focus's claim that what was found with the fathers is enough becomes a closure of inquiry: inherited practice is treated as a sufficient endpoint even when the surrounding pattern tests it against revelation, knowledge, and guidance.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers for the upward call, sufficiency, finding, and fathers contact repeated summons-and-refusal scenes in 2:170, 4:61, 31:21, and 7:28, while 9:59 and 43:22-23 relocate or repeat sufficiency around Allah, the Messenger, and ancestral tracks. The contact changes finding from a neutral report of encounter into a claimed warrant that blocks the call to tested guidance.
findings.reader_payoff: The reply becomes newly legible as the conversion of inherited availability into an epistemic stopping point, so the question about whether the fathers knew or were guided tests the warrant rather than merely criticizing family attachment.
findings.containment: This finding concerns inherited finding used as self-sufficient authority. It does not invalidate every transmission across generations; the separate descent-linked finding preserves a bounded case in which inherited continuity remains answerable to its source.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run finding is trusted but carries a weak retrieval grade, while the wider connection rows supply exact target Arabic as review nominations without target morphology. The relation is therefore retained with explicit qualification rather than treated as unqualified lexical proof.

findings.title: The messenger is a bounded transmission channel
findings.claim: The focus's Messenger destination becomes a bounded, source-checkable transmission channel: later supplied scenes limit the messenger to conveyance, expose attributed speech to audit, and bound human witness, so inherited confidence cannot validate itself merely by descent.
findings.mechanism: The focus Messenger contacts the supplied HFT coordinates at 5:99, 5:109, 5:116, and 5:117. Delivery is limited, the gathered messengers defer knowledge of reception, attributed speech is checked against an exact command, and witness is limited to presence; together these contacts change return to the Messenger from installing another unbounded lineage into returning to an auditable message chain.
findings.reader_payoff: The contrast becomes procedural: the reader can ask who delivered the message, what was actually said, and within what witness boundary instead of treating inherited authority as self-validating.
findings.containment: This is an attributed contextual resonance, not a claim that the legal, eschatological, and christological passages are one literal episode. Their separate local functions remain live while their shared transmission constraint is visible.

findings.title: The named source supplies the warrant test
findings.claim: The focus's named divine source makes inherited authority a warrant question: names or practices attributed to the fathers do not gain authorization merely from inheritance when the source's sanction is absent.

That contact changes the contrast between what Allah sent down and what the fathers supplied from a preference dispute into a source-authorization test.

findings.containment: The finding is limited to the source-and-warrant relation carried by the focus's divine name and the supplied parallels. It does not claim that every ancestral name or every inherited practice has the same status.

findings.title: An inherited track can be called guidance
findings.claim: The final negated guidance exposes a wider path-labeling problem: followers can call the track found with their fathers guidance, while the focus's question keeps direction answerable to knowledge and a source beyond the track itself.
findings.mechanism: The focus guidance carrier is contacted by 43:22-23, where found fathers and their tracks are explicitly paired with being guided or following, and by 37:70, where later people hasten upon forebears' tracks. The recurrence changes guidance from an unexamined label for inheritance into a direction that must be tested.
findings.reader_payoff: The last question becomes newly precise: it asks not only whether the fathers knew, but whether the route inherited from them deserves the name guidance.
findings.containment: The finding identifies the untested track in this authority dispute. It does not say that every inherited path is false or that the guidance branch loses its ordinary meaning.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and exact Arabic target evidence are present, but the cited rows are retrieval nominations without independent trust labels or target morphology. The recurrence supports a qualified global resonance, not a lexical disambiguation.
